the feedback that you send us.

## IVS Low-Latency Streaming API Reference

Changes

| API Change                                                                                                                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Date               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| [Multitrack<br>Video Integration API Reference](../BroadcastSWIntegAPIReference/integ-api-welcome.md "../BroadcastSWIntegAPIReference/integ-api-welcome.md") | We added Client as a separate object. Previously it was part of the<br>CapabilitiesDescription object. This affects the GetClientCapabilities<br>request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | February 7, 2025   |
| [Channel<br>Types](../LowLatencyAPIReference/channel-types.md "../LowLatencyAPIReference/channel-types.md")                                                  | We added audio bitrates and updated audio information.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | November 24, 2024  |
| Multitrack video                                                                                                                                             | We made many updates to the control-plane API, documented in the [IVS<br>Low-Latency Streaming API Reference](../LowLatencyAPIReference/Welcome.md "../LowLatencyAPIReference/Welcome.md"):<br>• Added IngestConfigurations and MultitrackInputConfiguration.<br>• Modified the IngestConfiguration description (to distinguish it from<br>IngestConfigurations).<br>• Modified AudioConfiguration (added `track`) and updated its<br>description to indicate it's part of both IngestConfiguration and<br>IngestConfigurations.<br>• Modified VideoConfiguration (added `level`, `profile`,<br>and `track`) and updated its description to indicate it's part of<br>both IngestConfiguration and IngestConfigurations.<br>• Modified Channel (added `containerFormat` and<br>`multitrackInputConfiguration`). This affects StreamSession (which<br>contains Channel) and several endpoints: BatchGetChannel response, CreateChannel<br>request and response, GetChannel response, GetStreamSession response, and<br>UpdateChannel request and response.<br>• Modified StreamEvent (description and new `code` values). This<br>affects `truncatedEvents` in StreamSession.<br>• Modified StreamSession (added `ingestConfigurations` and updated<br>the `ingestConfiguration` description).<br>• Modified ThumbnailConfiguration (added multitrack to the<br>`targetIntervalSeconds` description).<br>• In "Channel Types," created separate discussions of single-track and<br>multitrack video input.<br>On the [IVS documentation landing<br>page](../../../ivs.md "../../../ivs.md"), in the IVS Low-Latency Streaming section, we added a tile for [Multitrack<br>Video Integration API Reference](../BroadcastSWIntegAPIReference/integ-api-welcome.md "../BroadcastSWIntegAPIReference/integ-api-welcome.md"). This new document describes in detail all<br>operations for the IVS data-plane API for broadcast-software developers implementing<br>client support for multitrack video. The API is REST compatible, using a standard<br>HTTP API. | November 14, 2024  |
| Stream Takeover                                                                                                                                              | Added the `code` field to the StreamEvent object. This affects<br>one response: GetStreamSession.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | October 15, 2024   |
| Remove `svs` from ARN patterns                                                                                                                               | ARN patterns which specified `[is]vs` were updated to specify<br>`ivs`. This affects several endpoints (including all Tags endpoints)<br>and the following objects: BatchError, BatchStartViewerSessionRevocationError,<br>BatchStartViewerSessionRevocationViewerSession, Channel, ChannelSummary,<br>PlaybackKeyPair, PlaybackKayPairSummary, Stream, StreamSummary, StreamKey,<br>StreamKeySummary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | April 25, 2024     |
| Secure Reliable Transport ingest support                                                                                                                     | We added the `srt` field to the Channel object. This affects six<br>responses: BatchGetChannel, CreateChannel, GetChannel, UpdateChannel, and<br>GetStreamSession.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | April 4, 2024      |
| Tokenless playback restrictions                                                                                                                              | • Added a new resource, PlaybackRestrictionPolicy.<br>• Added five PlaybackRestrictionPolicy(ies) endpoints<br>(Create/Delete/Get/List/Update).<br>• Added the PlaybackRestrictionPolicy and PlaybackRestrictionPolicySummary<br>objects.<br>• Added `playbackRestrictionPolicyArn` to the Channel and<br>ChannelSummary objects. | IVS Real-Time Streaming launch | Major documentation changes accompany this release. We renamed the previous<br>documentation to be IVS Low-Latency Streaming and published new IVS Real-Time<br>Streaming documentation. The [IVS<br>documentation landing page](../../../ivs.md "../../../ivs.md") now has separate sections for real-time<br>streaming and low-latency streaming. Each section has its own User Guide and API<br>Reference.<br>The Stage API Reference is part of IVS real-time streaming documentation, where<br>it was renamed [IVS Real-Time Streaming API<br>Reference](../RealTimeAPIReference/index.md "../RealTimeAPIReference/index.md"). We will list future updates to this API Reference in [Document<br>History (Real-Time Streaming)](../RealTimeUserGuide/doc-history.md "../RealTimeUserGuide/doc-history.md"), not here. | August 7, 2023 |
